title: Human Resource Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities Talent Acquisition & Management:  Handling recruitment, onboarding, and placement to align staff skills with the bank's strategic goals. Performance & Compensation Management:  Developing performance appraisal systems, managing payroll, benefits, and promotions based on merit. Training & Development:  Identifying training needs and implementing programs to enhance skills, specifically related to cooperative banking principles. Employee Relations & Compliance:  Managing grievances, ensuring compliance with labor laws, and maintaining documentation to meet regulatory scrutiny. Workforce Planning & Culture:  Developing HR policies, fostering a cooperative work environment, and ensuring staff motivation.

Key Skills: Human Resource Management,Employee Engagement,Employee Retention,Resource,Resource management,Retention,Engagement,Management
